Package nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.tiles

Class Door

java.lang.Object
nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.tiles.AbstractTile
nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.tiles.Door
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Tile>, ModifiableTile, Tile, JSONSerializable<ModifiableTile>
Direct Known Subclasses:
KeyDoor, TreasureDoor
public abstract sealed class Door extends AbstractTile implements ModifiableTile permits TreasureDoor, KeyDoor
door tiles are a tile that initially functions similar to a wall but once an entity attempts to enter it when its unlock requirements are satisfied it will unlock and act like an Empty tile
